resources.string: agentreins-moblie uses Accessibility to read the text and buttons on screen. With this on, agentreins-moblie turns on its own accessibility service in system settings for you; other accessibility services you have on aren’t affected. Turn this off and agentreins-moblie turns its own service off.

With this on, agentreins-moblie adds itself to the system’s battery optimization exceptions, so it isn’t stopped in the background to save power and phone control drops less often. It may use a bit more battery. Turn it off to go back to the system default.

“Wireless debugging” turns itself off after a restart. With this on, agentreins-moblie turns it back on at startup and reconnects. This needs the “Modify system settings” permission, used only to turn on Wireless debugging, and works only on Wi-Fi you’ve trusted. Turning this off or unpairing returns the permission.

After Wi-Fi drops or the phone restarts, the system turns “Wireless debugging” off. Phone control normally doesn’t need it — only when restarting (for example after a agentreins-moblie update). With this on, in those moments and while on Wi-Fi, agentreins-moblie turns it on and reconnects, but never turns it off for you. This uses the same “Modify system settings” permission as “Restore after restart” and works only on Wi-Fi you’ve allowed. Turn it off and agentreins-moblie stops doing this.
Couldn’t finish. Make sure phone control is ready and try again.
The accessibility service was restarted automatically at %1$s.

Wireless debugging isn’t allowed on this Wi-Fi yet, so agentreins-moblie can’t turn it on. Turn it on once yourself and tick “Always allow on this network” when asked; after that agentreins-moblie can turn it on by itself.
This phone doesn’t let agentreins-moblie turn on Wireless debugging. Turn it on yourself when needed and agentreins-moblie will connect.
agentreins-moblie turned on Wireless debugging a few times but phone control still didn’t start, so it stopped. Switch Wi-Fi or tap Retry in Phone control and agentreins-moblie will try again.
At the last startup the permission was gone, so it couldn’t restore. Turn this switch off and on again.
This phone doesn’t let agentreins-moblie turn on Wireless debugging at startup. After a restart, turn it on yourself and agentreins-moblie will connect.
Couldn’t reconnect automatically at the last startup. Make sure you’re on trusted Wi-Fi with Wireless debugging on, and agentreins-moblie will connect.
